name: .510 Cal-570gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist for Big Game Hunting is 1-25″ or faster. Minimum required twist for Dangerous Game Hunting is 1-22″ or faster. Recommended use: Big Game and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This 50 caliber Stone Hammer™ is designed in the traditional weight of 570gr for regulation in the double rifles. This pure copper bullet will handle any of the dangerous game animals on the planet. It will expand and shed weight while still penetrating as well as a solid. This will give you the large permanent wound channel for quick kills and still be able to penetrate deeply for the largest and thickest-skinned animals."
